activity.notes: Ferdinand was installed as Count of Castile after the murder of García Sánchez in 1029 and retained Castile while later acquiring the León crown in 1037/1038. Modern scholarship differs over retrospective use of a separate Castilian royal title during Ferdinand's lifetime, but the comital authority itself is well attested. ATLAS therefore preserves the County of Castile as a distinct concurrent political Activity through Ferdinand's death in 1065 without inventing an anachronistic Kingdom of Castile before the succession of Sancho II.
